stem: Two ships are initially at rest, with ship B 1000 m east of ship A. Both ships start moving simultaneously, with ‘A’ having a velocity of 10 m/s SE and B having a velocity of 20 m/s in SW. What would be shortest possible distance between the two ships?

assets.alt: N–E axes with ship A at the origin and B to the east; A moves 10 SE and B 20 SW. The relative velocity v_BA = v_B − v_A is drawn from B, and d_min is the perpendicular distance from A to it.
